instructions: Does the betting-window design have a race where a bet passes validation just before close but is created after close (accept-then-close inconsistency)?
Does debit-before-create risk permanent lost funds if the process dies between debit and bet-create and recovery is not implemented?
Can a client bypass idempotency (e.g. omitting/changing the key per retry) to cause double debit?
Will echoing serverTime/betting_end_at on rejection FAIL to prevent late-bet disputes from clock drift?
Does the reconnect snapshot design risk leaking hole cards before RESULT (e.g. redaction bug)?
Is awarding the 1-unit tie remainder to the earliest seat an unfairness/dispute risk requiring a different rule?
Can per-round event_seq with 500-cap log LOSE events under load, breaking client state recovery?
Does the cancel→void-debit path risk double-refund or missed refund (bets voided but credit not sent)?
Does any part of the design let the client be authoritative for balance, bets, results or payouts?
Overall design soundness for server-authoritative multiplayer?
criteria: acceptable with fixes to flagged items
